- Collected the typed RuntimeConfigV2, PostgresConfig, DcsConfig, LoggingConfig, ApiConfig, PgRoute, ApiRoute, Secret, and PgClientTls definitions needed to replace the render/parse test round-trip with a direct constructor in load_config.rs.

- Moved parser runtime fixture rendering into load_config.rs test helpers and am removing the now-dead render/trim/join/document helpers from private_schema.rs.

- Deleted the runtime test renderer corridor from private_schema.rs and finished moving runtime TOML fixture generation into load_config.rs tests.
- Ran cargo fmt successfully; next step is make check, then the remaining required make lint / make test / make test-long sequence if checks pass.

- make test exposed a parser-fixture regression in load_runtime_config_and_timing_values_normalize_zero_runtime_fields: dotted keys appended after the final [dcs] table were parsed under dcs.
- Fixed that by rewriting the zero-default extra section to use explicit [postgres], [ha], [process.timeouts], [process.binaries.overrides], and [logging.postgres.cleanup] tables.
- Because code changed after the first clean check/lint pass, next step is to rerun cargo fmt and the full make check / make lint / make test / make test-long sequence.

- Full make test rerun showed one more parser-fixture issue: the explicit [logging.postgres.cleanup] section also needs its required enabled field.
- Added enabled = true and am doing one focused cargo nextest run for the previously failing parser test before rerunning the entire required validation chain again.

- The explicit [logging.postgres] workaround kept materializing partial parent tables, so I changed the local runtime fixture renderer to emit dcs.endpoints as a dotted root key instead of a trailing [dcs] table and reverted the zero-default overrides back to dotted keys.
- Running cargo fmt plus the focused nextest for the previously failing parser test again; if green, I will restart the full required validation chain once more.

- Flattened the runtime parser fixture helper entirely to dotted keys, which removed the lingering table-context parse issues.
- Added logging.postgres.cleanup.enabled = true after the focused lib test showed cleanup still requires its explicit enabled field.
- If the focused parser test passes now, I will rerun make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long from scratch.

- Full make test narrowed the remaining parser fixture issue further: any logging.* override materializes the logging table, so the fixture also needs logging.capture_subprocess_output.
- Added that field and am restarting the required validation chain again from make check.

- make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long all passed after finishing the fixture-local renderer refactor and direct runtime test config constructor.
- Next step is final Ralph bookkeeping: verify current total lines, prevent this plan from re-executing next turn, run task_switch.sh, commit all changes, and push.
